# Strap

> Strap is a retail operations platform by Kryonara. It connects point of sale, products, inventory, customers, staff, branches, expenses, reports and online orders in one workspace.

Canonical website: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/

## Product

Strap is designed for retail business owners, managers and staff who need a consistent way to run daily shop operations across physical locations and an online storefront.

Primary workflows:
- Point of sale and transaction records
- Product catalogue, inventory and stock visibility
- Customer records
- Staff roles and access
- Branch and location management
- Expenses and business reporting
- Online storefront, catalogue and incoming orders
- Barcode scanning and receipt workflows on compatible devices

## Plans

- Free: core selling and product workflows, one staff seat and one branch.
- Business: online storefront, advanced inventory and reporting, up to five staff members and three branches.
- Pro: Business capabilities with expanded staff and branch capacity.

Current public monthly prices are listed on the pricing page. Prices are shown in Nigerian naira and may change; use the live pricing page as the source of truth.

## Important product boundaries

- Strap records configured payment methods for in-store sales. Merchant payment processing is not currently enabled as a production feature.
- Strap supports a remote MCP integration for compatible AI clients. A general-purpose public REST API reference is not currently published.
- Product screenshots are not included in this documentation. Illustrative interface previews and editorial retail photography should not be represented as customer screenshots or customer endorsements.
